BIOTECH · THE VALUE CHAIN


The value chain by layer
Median EBITDA margin by layer: Research tools and diagnostics suppliers 28.7%; Bioprocessing suppliers and diversified healthcare 21.4%; Large pharma and biotech portfolios
30.1% (14 of 15 companies). Stock-based pay differs 2.1 times between these layers (Research tools and diagnostics suppliers 2.4% of revenue, Large pharma and biotech
portfolios 5.1%), and an EBITDA margin counts it as a cost, so they are not ranked on it.

ranked only on a median of at least 5 companies with the figure; a layer with fewer is shown, not ranked. A median is shown for 3 companies or more. Each compared layer's
companies by name, the rules and the capital figures: p. 58. Companies: those in the layer's calculations, “of” those the layer lists where some are left out (who and why: the

clinical-stage biotechs (2); Designs licensed for royalties (1); each layer's page names them.
